name: Cuiabá (Brazil)
description: Vertical bicolour of green and white charged with a yellow shield bearing VILA REAL DO BOM JESUS DE CUIABÁ in red and the date 1719 around a green triangle with a yellow mound.
history: Cuiabá is the capital of the state of Mato Grosso, Brazil. Portuguese Wikipedia records that the flag was created by Nilton Benedito de Santana with the support of the journalist Pedro Rocha Jucá and made official by Mayor José Villanova Torres through Decree No. 241 of 29 December 1972; the shield recalls the original arms granted to the Vila Real do Bom Jesus de Cuiabá in 1719.

features.role: shield reading VILA REAL DO BOM JESUS DE CUIABÁ 1719 with a green triangle
